description: This file contains unit tests for the ModuleActivator component within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing module start/stop lifecycle methods and dependencies via JUnit 5.

classes.name: ModuleActivatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for verifying the correct behaviour of module activation lifecycle methods in OpenMRS.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStartOnStartup
methods.description: Verifies that the willStart() method is invoked exactly once for each module at startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallStartedOnStartup
methods.description: Ensures that the started() method is not called immediately after startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallWillStopOnStartup
methods.description: Checks that willStop() is not invoked during startup.

methods.name: shouldNotCallStoppedOnStartup
methods.description: Checks that stopped() is not invoked during startup.

methods.name: shouldStartModulesInOrder
methods.description: Verifies that modules start in dependency order: module1, then module2, then module3.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnlyForStoppedModule
methods.description: Ensures only the specific module being stopped has its willStop() and stopped() called.

methods.name: shouldStopDependantModulesOnStopModule
methods.description: Verifies that stopping a module causes dependent modules to also stop, in the correct order.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnShutdown
methods.description: Checks that the shutdown process calls willStop() and stopped() for all modules.

methods.name: shouldExcludePreviouslyStoppedModulesOnShutdown
methods.description: Verifies that modules marked as previously stopped are excluded from stop calls during shutdown.

methods.name: shouldCallWillStopAndStoppedOnUnloadModule
methods.description: Ensures that unloading a module triggers willStop() and stopped() only for that module.

methods.name: shouldStartBeforeAnotherModule
methods.description: Checks that module5 starts before module4 according to start time order.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: A cleanup method executed after all tests to ensure no residual effects interfere with other tests.
